name: Bookings Calendar for WooCommerce
author: moiseh

sections.description:
Provides nice availability calendar shortcode, making the proccess of booking more intuitive and easier to the end user.

This plugin uses FullCalendar library to renderize the calendar, so it’s have great customizability.

To add the availability calendar, just add the [wbc-calendar] shortcode in your page.

Attention: This plugin is an addon for the official WooCommerce Bookings extension. It just provides the frontend calendar view, not booking functionalities nor booking type related products.

Premium version features:

  • Allow to define product-specific colors view demo
  • Allow to add availability calendar as widget using drag and drop
  • Allow to filter by specified product and categories in plugin settings and shortcode
  • Open bookings directly in AJAX modal and display tooltip on event mouseover view demo
  • Reverse calendar logic to display only taken slots
  • Perform calendar search using AJAX without page reload view demo
  • Support for WooCommerce Booking Accommodations
sections.installation:
1. Upload woo-bookings-calendar.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. It’s done. Now you can go to the Settings to configure what you want
sections.faq:
Why my calendar events taking so much time to load?

When it happens the most common issue is the user is viewing calendar in Month mode, and bookable products are divided by small blocks of days, hours or minutes. This cause heavy CPU load to calculate events availability, and the solution is to set higher Booking duration blocks, or/and limit the calendar to display only in Day or/and Week mode.

  • Changed: a cleaner Get PRO tab — the PRO features one per row with a check, a red YouTube “Watch demo” button for each feature video, and the buy button at the top and the bottom
  • Fixed: a settings tab whose name has a space opened empty
  • Changed: a cleaner settings page — the settings in a card, one row each with the label and its field aligned, on/off settings as switches, multiple choices as chips, a setting’s sub-options in a panel under it, and Reset set apart from Save

1.0.38

  • Fixed: on phones the week and day views showed a strip of three hours (06:00–09:00) and hid the bookable slots below it; a narrow calendar is now taller and its time grid opens at the first slot (unless a scrollTime is set through the wbc_fullcalendar_options filter)

1.0.37

  • Security: the [wbc-calendar] shortcode attributes (cat, product, default-view, startdate) are validated and escaped, and so is the event search field (CVE-2024-31117, Cross Site Scripting)
  • Security: removed the debug output that any visitor could trigger, and the product ids and dates read from the request are validated
  • Updated FullCalendar to 6.1.15 (the 3.x calendar placed time-grid events wrong in current browsers)
  • Fixed slot exclusions that were never applied and slots built twice; bookings are read once per product
  • The common classes carry the plugin’s prefix, so other MH plugins no longer clash with it
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.2
  • Renamed to Bookings Calendar for WooCommerce
  • Compatible with WooCommerce Bookings 3.x (tested with 3.8.0), which lists the time slots by their start time: the calendar showed no event with it. 1.x still works
